contradiction_analysis.apparent_paradox: High overall median p_low for actual_low vs low test recall
contradiction_analysis.root_cause: Overall diagnostics pool train+validation+test. Train rows (~78% of stacked rows) show extreme overfit (median p_low|low≈1, recall@0.02=1.0). Test-only median p_low|actual_low is near zero, so recall stays low.
